record.dic_text:
02246 Chobab {kho-bawb'}

源自 02245; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Hobab 2; 2

何巴 = "被珍愛的"
1) 流珥的兒子, 摩西的岳父, 一個米甸人, 也稱作葉忒羅, 並且是摩西的內兄
record.edic_text:
02246 Chobab {kho-bawb'}

from 02245;; n pr m

AV - Hobab 2; 2

Hobab = "cherished"
1) the son of Reuel, the Midianite father-in-law of Moses, also known
   as Jethro, and brother-in-law of Moses
